run_COVOST_PREP: run the CoVoST data preparation script to extract features and generate manifests for speech-to-text
create_COVOST_DATASET: create a CoVoST dataset instance to load speech translation samples with waveform and translation data
process_COVOST_DATA: process CoVoST data by extracting fbank features, creating ZIP archives, and generating TSV manifests
build_COVOST_MANIFEST: build TSV manifest files from CoVoST dataset splits with audio paths and target text
generate_COVOST_CONFIG: generate a config YAML and vocabulary model for CoVoST speech-to-text or ASR tasks
